name: LibreChat
description: Enhanced, open-source ChatGPT-style web UI supporting many AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Azure, and local models) with conversation search, multi-user auth, and a plugins ecosystem. Self-contained stack with MongoDB and Meilisearch.

env.label: Credentials Encryption Key
env.description: 32-byte key in hex (exactly 64 hex characters) used to encrypt stored provider credentials. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

env.label: Credentials Encryption IV
env.description: 16-byte initialization vector in hex (exactly 32 hex characters) used with the credentials key. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 16

env.label: JWT Secret
env.description: Secret used to sign access tokens. A random value is generated automatically; recommended length is 32 bytes (64 hex chars), e.g. openssl rand -hex 32.

env.label: JWT Refresh Secret
env.description: Secret used to sign refresh tokens. A random value is generated automatically; recommended length is 32 bytes (64 hex chars), e.g. openssl rand -hex 32.

env.label: Meilisearch Master Key
env.description: Master key for the Meilisearch full-text search engine. Must be at least 16 bytes of valid UTF-8. Auto-generated; shared between the LibreChat app and the Meilisearch service.

env.label: OpenAI API Key
env.description: API key for OpenAI; optional, can also be set in the UI.

env.label: Anthropic API Key
env.description: API key for Anthropic; optional, can also be set in the UI.
